plain: A lessening of the force or worth of a law or right.

webster.text: The act of annulling or revoking a law, or some part of it.

example.quote: If the state judiciaries could make decisions conformable to the laws of their states, in derogation to the general government, I humbly apprehend that the federal government would soon be encroached ujjon.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
